categories.main_business_segments: Anhui Shunyu Water Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the water services industry, focusing on secondary water supply and sewage treatment. The company also develops smart water management platforms to support intelligent operations. Its business model integrates energy-saving and low-carbon technology R&D, high-end intelligent equipment manufacturing, big data integration, and smart algorithm platform construction, forming a dual-driven approach in water supply and environmental governance.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies including IoT-based intelligent water supply systems, distributed pump station control platforms, and water big data analytics. It has developed energy-saving peak-shifting smart water supply systems with proprietary algorithms for dynamic load adjustment and pressure balancing. Manufacturing includes vertical multistage centrifugal pumps and modular sewage treatment equipment, with a focus on digitalization, automation, and green manufacturing processes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include municipal water supply enterprises, urban and rural residential communities, industrial parks, and government entities involved in urban infrastructure and environmental protection. The company serves markets across urban water supply, sewage treatment, and water environment governance, with projects spanning from new construction to renovation and operation of water facilities.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across China, covering 24 provincial-level regions including Anhui, Zhejiang, Shanghai, Henan, Jiangsu, Tianjin, Beijing, Guangdong, Guangxi, Hainan, Shanxi, Fujian, Sichuan, Shaanxi, Gansu, Inner Mongolia, Tibet, Shandong, Hunan, Jiangxi, Hubei, Chongqing, and Xinjiang. It has also expanded into western regions such as Tibet and Gansu through subsidiaries.
categories.supply_chain_position: Anhui Shunyu Water functions primarily as a midstream and downstream player in the water supply and environmental services supply chain. It manufactures and supplies water supply and sewage treatment equipment, provides engineering construction services, and offers operation and maintenance services, positioning itself as a comprehensive solution provider from equipment manufacturing to smart operation.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in energy-saving, low-carbon technologies, smart water supply systems, and modular sewage treatment solutions. It invests heavily in AI, big data, and digital twin technologies to enhance water system management. Strategic projects include the development of peak-shifting smart water supply systems, industrial wastewater treatment technologies, and integrated digital operation platforms, aiming to lead in smart water services and support China's dual carbon goals.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of water supply and sewage treatment equipment, engineering construction contracts (including EPC and BOT/PPP projects), and operation and maintenance service fees. The company also earns income from government subsidies, investment returns, and financial asset management. Its business includes upfront equipment sales and long-term service contracts.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: While specific competitors are not named, Anhui Shunyu Water is positioned as a leading national high-tech enterprise and a specialized 'little giant' in the water services sector. It holds a strong market position due to its advanced technology, comprehensive service offerings, and recognized brand in the secondary water supply and sewage treatment markets. The company emphasizes differentiation through smart, energy-efficient solutions and integrated lifecycle services.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 652.6 million, a 7.36% decrease from the previous year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 13.65 million, down 79.84%. Total assets reached about RMB 3.12 billion, growing 6.99% year-over-year. Despite recent profit declines, the company continues to invest in R&D and expand its market presence, including acquisitions and new subsidiaries, indicating a focus on long-term growth and technological leadership.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Anhui Shunyu Water differentiates itself by offering integrated, intelligent water supply and sewage treatment solutions that emphasize energy efficiency, low carbon emissions, and smart management. Its proprietary peak-shifting smart water supply system and modular sewage treatment technologies provide customers with reliable, sustainable, and cost-effective water services. The company’s comprehensive lifecycle services, from design and manufacturing to operation and maintenance, combined with strong R&D capabilities and national certifications, create a competitive edge in delivering high-quality, innovative water infrastructure solutions.
